note: descriptive, for Almagest; not in the science record

rules.bins: 20 equal-count if each ≥ 500; else n//100 (max 20) if ≥ 10; else THIN (no γ)
rules.NOISE: split-half cos(w_a, w_b) ≤ max over 5 label shuffles (same galaxies, same halves)
rules.PROXY: ratio floor: AUC − 0.5 < 0.05 → WEAK, transfer not applied; transfer ratio ≥ 0.9, X STRONG, other question, mutual → decision-path ancestor else higher AUC; conditional test: Y's AUC within 10 equal-count bins of d_X (bin-weighted), bootstrap 95% CI (1000) above the max of 5 shuffled-label probes (sign-aligned) → SEPARATE; chains followed to a STRONG/SEPARATE root
rules.WEAK/STRONG: stable; cleaned test AUC within/below vs above the 3 untrained seeds' max (cleaned the same way)
rules.tail_flag: γ on the poorly-voted half (reach < median) vs the full γ, or the two halves: tail (s ≥ 0.8) mean gap at matched d > 2.0× overall
rules.planes: both STRONG or SEPARATE and |corr(d_X, d_Y)| < null + 0.1, null = max |r| over 5 paired shuffled-label probes
rules.PROXY_sigma_w (superseded): |cos(Σw, Σw_X)| ≥ 0.8, X STRONG (base label) in another question
